_about: Task-to-code retrieval benchmark for this repository. 'gold' lists acceptable answers as name or file:name. A case with an empty gold list is a negative: the correct behaviour is to return nothing confident. Kinds: natural (plain-language task, function name unknown), exact (function name given), error (an error or log message given).
